l.i: Cui nec Parrhasius par, nec in arte
Mentis at heróæ quis potuisset opes?
Sicut adhuc vivi spirat imago viri.
At quāvis tātæ fuerint: quin major & alter
Abstulit infelix nihilo mors secius ambos:
Quæ tamē in famā nil modò juris habet.
Virtuti hórum igitur qui insisset, & ipse

page.notes: Red ink underlining and marks on the lines "toto notissimus orbe", "Parrhasius par" and "testantur" are handwritten annotations, not print, so they are left out. The "(viden'?)" query is printed in the text as shown. The "Cæsaribus", "quāvis" and "tātæ" readings are read from a small scan and should be checked against the original.
